description: This script manages authentication directories and files for various providers used in a Docker environment, providing functions to normalize inputs, determine inclusion criteria, collect directories and files from CSV inputs and overrides, and to join CSV values.

methods.name: openclaw_live_trim
methods.description: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from input string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_normalize_auth_dir
methods.description: Normalizes authentication directory input by trimming and prepending '.' if needed.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_dir_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth directory for specific provider based on input.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_file_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth file for specific provider based on input.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_csv
methods.description: Collects and de-duplicates auth directories based on CSV input.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_override
methods.description: Returns auth directories based on override variable or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs
methods.description: Collects auth directories, prioritizing override if available.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_csv
methods.description: Collects and de-duplicates auth files based on CSV input.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_override
methods.description: Returns auth files based on override variable or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files
methods.description: Collects auth files, prioritizing override if available.

methods.name: openclaw_live_join_csv
methods.description: Joins multiple strings into a single CSV line.
